classes.name: Defender
classes.description: +25% max health and takes 20% less damage. Favors protective skills: Firewall Rule, Access Lockdown, Site Survey, Rollback Plan and Key Vault.

classes.name: Analyst
classes.description: Heals 8 health for every correct answer, and weak points take 1.75x damage instead of 1.5x. Favors investigative skills: Patch Deploy, Honeypot Lure, Zero Trust Verify, Impact Scan, Version Lock and Stego Veil.

classes.name: Cryptographer
classes.description: +25% damage on every skill, but 15% less max health. Favors cryptography skills: Integrity Check, Key Exchange, Certificate Seal and Hash Strike.
